name: Air-Fryer Stuffed Parwal
ingredients: 8 small parwal (pointed gourd), scraped and slit lengthways
½ tsp each fennel, coriander powder, amchur and chilli powder
steps: Par-boil the parwal for 3 minutes; drain and cool.
Heat half the oil, cook the onion for 3 minutes, then add the tofu, besan and spices and cook 4 minutes. Cool.
Stuff each parwal and tie with thread or press closed.
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C, brush the parwal with the remaining oil and cook for 15–18 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned.
note: A UP classic; the tofu and besan filling replaces the traditional fried potato filling.
